_comment: Drop a copy of this at <repo-root>/.iterate-issues.json (without the leading dot in the example name) to override defaults for /iterate-issues. All keys are optional.
_comment_standingDecisions: Answers a human already gave, so the same question never triggers needs-human twice. Agents cite entries and act; agents may PROPOSE entries but only humans commit them. See 'Standing decisions' in iterate-issues.md.

standingDecisions.decision: Cron schedules stay in vercel.json at their functional frequency; the plan is upgraded to support them. A deploy failure on cron frequency is not a decision point — proceed, note the plan dependency in the PR body.
standingDecisions.scope: vercel.json crons frequency vs Hobby/Pro plan limits

_comment_liveQa: How an agent can run a real-browser QA pass on this repo without a human. loginScript is a repo-committed script that reads secrets from .env.local itself and authenticates the session — the QA agent runs it, never handles or types a secret. Embedded verbatim in the batch PR's QA section (Step 5.3).
